title: Selective Context Under a Claim-Scoped Evidence Contract: A Synthetic Runtime Characterization of Token-Bleed R5

source_lineage.statement: Results were collected at collection_revision. privacy_safe_release_revision is its descendant and adds public result artifacts without changing collection source. preprint_source_revision is the merged preprint source snapshot. Set the Zenodo related identifier to the immutable release that contains this approved release card immediately before deposit.

evidence_boundary: Auditable derived-evidence package. The original raw report remains private because its hardware provenance contains host identifiers. The public packet retains a commented raw-report SHA-256 provenance reference and privacy-safe derived evidence, but does not permit independent inspection or recomputation from raw outputs.

portfolio_role.primary: Reference application of ACE's retained-evidence and claim-scoped assessment discipline. The durable contribution is the auditable decision boundary, including a rejected lexical token-efficiency claim, not a claim that a benchmark configuration is universally superior.
portfolio_role.supports: A bounded synthetic input to the Enterprise Agent Architecture context-plane thesis: context selection changes the information presented to a model. It does not establish action authority, authorization enforcement, policy-engine effectiveness, or production safety.
portfolio_role.does_not_compete_with: The Agent Security Harness, which evaluates protocol and capability-boundary failure modes. R5 is not a security evaluation and must not be positioned as harness performance evidence.
portfolio_role.publication_role: A citable technical experiment report and provenance artifact. Any PubPoint, LinkedIn, or sector narrative must preserve the synthetic, local-endpoint, bundled-route, and rejected-lexical-claim boundaries and must follow applicable cadence gates.

accepted_claim_scope: At 0% candidate-generator misses, in this named local endpoint and synthetic task configuration, the bundled compact governed route used 96.9%-97.9% fewer mean prompt tokens and achieved higher mean F1 than the verbose full-catalog route. It did not meet the frozen 3x prompt-token-ratio rule versus the lexical negative control.
prohibited_claims: The oracle-controlled candidate generator is an evaluated classifier or retriever.
The bundled compact route beats lexical filtering generally.
This is a production policy-engine result.
